brief:
Palestinian security forces arrested Yaqoub Abu al-Muna on Saturday, according to Shehab Wire. Abu al-Muna is the father of Abdel-Rahman Abu al-Muna, who was killed on March 10, 2025, shot by Palestinian Authority security personnel during a pursuit operation.

The detention comes weeks after security forces under the same Authority apparatus fatally shot the younger Abu al-Muna. Details surrounding the March pursuit operation and the circumstances of the son's death remain unclear. The arrest marks an apparent escalation in a case already involving the death of a civilian at the hands of Authority security.
